target: Locate a failure and test a causal remedy for hippocampal replay using a replay schedule with online and offline phases. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

competency.title: Diagnose hippocampal replay — human review
competency.outcome: Locate a failure and test a causal remedy for hippocampal replay using a replay schedule with online and offline phases. Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.

topic_kernel.artifact: a replay schedule with online and offline phases
topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: claiming a biological mechanism from an engineering analogy

competency.practice_task: Produce a fault trace, hypothesis table and controlled repair grounded in a replay schedule with online and offline phases.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a reviewer who did not author the artifact or see hidden answers.
required_evidence: a fault trace, hypothesis table and controlled repair
Include reviewer notes, disagreement resolution and audit trail.
Report retention after delayed reactivation with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: claiming a biological mechanism from an engineering analogy.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of hippocampal replay.
Practice: the repair fixes the target without hiding a regression.
Measurement: report retention after delayed reactivation against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for claiming a biological mechanism from an engineering analogy; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
